resident make-up artists, hair stylists and fashion stylists

our MUAs, stylists and hair stylists are available for booking

Our skilled resident makeup artists at aether art space are available for hire, offering their expertise to both models and photographers renting the studio.

Each artist brings a distinctive style, ensuring that every look is tailored to enhance the vision of the shoot, whether it's natural elegance or bold, creative expression. With an eye for detail and a commitment to flawless application, our makeup artists elevate any project, helping bring concepts to life with precision and artistry. Book today to add the perfect finishing touch to your next photoshoot.
